title: Two students are killed by a bus in Dhaka
detail: The deaths triggered immediate public grief and anger, especially among school and college students.

title: Students occupy roads and demand accountability
detail: Protesters checked licenses, blocked roads, and demanded transport reform, turning road safety into a wider civic issue.

title: Attacks on students, journalists, and critics intensify
detail: Security forces and pro-government actors were accused of beating protesters and targeting activists and reporters documenting the abuse.

title: The movement recedes but leaves a durable public memory
detail: Even after the streets cleared, the movement remained a defining symbol of disciplined youth protest and the fragility of public accountability.
